title: Nutty Crunchy Venezuelan Chicken Empanadas
description: A resinous and snappy Venezuelan dish featuring tahini paste and halal-friendly ingredients, perfect for a brunch mood. The empanadas are shaped like nigiri for a unique twist.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, cumin, and paprika.
Add the warm water and olive oil to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle using a rolling pin.
In a separate bowl, mix together the chicken, onion, garlic, and tahini paste.
Place a tablespoon of the chicken mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
